title: Unconditionally stable and energy conserving discretization of the dynamic von Kármán equations
summary: A fully discrete approximation of the dynamic von Kármán equations combines nonconforming Morley finite element methods for spatial discretization with an energy conserving modified unconditionally stable Newmark second- order time-stepping scheme. Brouwer's fixed-point theorem establishes existence of a solution to the fully discrete scheme and further uniqueness and stability estimates follow for small loads.
